response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing financial risk/credit systems — critical gaps for a CTO role requiring executive leadership and deep fintech-AI integration.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven track record in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and real-time data handling
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication via workshops and talks
concerns: No demonstrated experience in fintech infrastructure, credit risk, or regulatory compliance systems
Lacks evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or building senior technical leadership layers
No clear production deployment of multi-agent AI systems with feedback loops or observability in high-stakes commercial settings
